town_description: Sarangarh is a town on National Highway 216, about 52 km from Raigarh and 200 km from Raipur, and now the headquarters of Sarangarh-Bilaigarh district. It was formerly the seat of a princely state. Nearby attractions include the Gomarda wildlife sanctuary, about 15 km away, and a World War II-era airstrip 6 km towards Raigarh.
